crossRefs.note: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that…
Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
May Yahweh therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of…
But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by man’s judgment. Yes, I don’t judge my own…
But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
“Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that…
A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom…
Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.
My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices.…
But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”
The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by…
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will…

translations.web: Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
translations.bsb: Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
translations.kjv: Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.
translations.asv: Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in Jehovah without wavering.
